dict.Cine predă scrie cantitatea trimisă; cin: The sender enters the quantity sent; the receiver enters what was counted on arrival: the differences are calculated automatically.
dict.În fișa de magazie (Sheets → Fișa de mag: On the stock card (Sheets → Stock card) it is an issue for the sending store and a receipt for the receiving one.
dict.Marfa mutată dintr-un depozit sau magazi: Goods moved from one warehouse or shop to another: quantity sent versus quantity counted on receipt, with the price; you get the differences in quantity and in lei, shortages (red), surpluses (yellow), the value sent and the transfer status: fully received, not received yet or received with differences.
dict.Pentru lipsuri se face proces-verbal și: For shortages, draw up a report and ask for the explanatory note (Docs → Stock keeper explanatory note).
